name: Andromeda ~ Sonogo
source:
Taking place after "Perseus and Andromeda", Satsuki receives a request to perform for a TV documentary.
But wait, for the filming she has to be entirely naked....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ265272.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事承接《珀耳修斯与安德洛墨达》之后，皋月收到了一份出演电视纪录片的委托。
可是且慢——为了完成这次拍摄，她竟然必须全程一丝不挂地出镜……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ265272.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
